name: Starbucks Coffee Beans Akabane
nameJa: スターバックス コーヒー ビーンズ赤羽店
description: A station-building Starbucks inside the Beans Akabane complex with public Wi-Fi and outlet-equipped seating, though it gets crowded at peak commuter times.

name: Doutor Coffee Shop Beans Akabane
nameJa: ドトールコーヒーショップ ビーンズ赤羽店
description: A cheap Doutor in the Beans Akabane station building offering Wi-Fi and some outlet seats, popular with commuters for short work sessions.

name: Starbucks Coffee AEON Style Akabane
nameJa: スターバックス コーヒー イオンスタイル赤羽店
address: 3-12-1 Kamiya, AEON Style Akabane, Kita-ku, Tokyo
description: Inside the AEON Style Akabane mall in Kamiya (a fair distance from Akabane station), this Starbucks has Wi-Fi and outlet seating in a roomier shopping-mall setting.

name: Starbucks Coffee Oji-ekimae
nameJa: スターバックス コーヒー 王子駅前店
description: A convenient ground-floor Starbucks right in front of Oji station with Wi-Fi and outlet seats, open long hours for early-morning or evening work.

name: Starbucks Coffee atre vie Tabata
nameJa: スターバックス コーヒー アトレヴィ田端店
address: 1-17-2 Higashi-Tabata, atre vie Tabata 2F, Kita-ku, Tokyo
description: A Starbucks in the atre vie Tabata station building that normally offers Wi-Fi and outlet seats, but as of mid-2026 its Wi-Fi is suspended due to building construction, so confirm before relying on it.

name: Pronto Higashi-Jujo
nameJa: プロント 東十条店
description: A cafe-by-day, bar-by-night Pronto near Higashi-Jujo station with customer power outlets, free Wi-Fi and 68 seats, one of the area's better long-session spots.

name: Doutor Coffee Shop Higashi-Jujo
nameJa: ドトールコーヒーショップ 東十条店
description: An inexpensive 61-seat Doutor near Higashi-Jujo station with confirmed free Wi-Fi that works for light laptop use, though per-seat power is not documented so bring a charged battery.
